Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw will flag off the Yeshwantpur-Mangaluru-Madgaon-Yeshwantpur Vande Bharat Express on November 13 from Bengaluru and Mangaluru Junction simultaneously.
The Railway Board has arranged two brand-new 16-car Vande Bharat rakes in orange livery for the inauguration as well as regular services. The rakes are stabled in Bengaluru and Mangaluru respectively ahead of the flag-off.
Thank you for watching our video!
